description: Estaciones depuradoras de aguas residuales (EDAR) del Canal de Isabel II, en la Comunidad de Madrid is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by idem.comunidad.madrid. Location of the Water Treatment Stations (EDAR), whose nominal treatment capacity exceeds 17 million equivalent inhabitants, distributed throughout the territory of the Community of Madrid and managed by Canal de Isabel II. The UWWTP, together with other infrastructures, allows the treatment of 100% of the wastewater generated. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs) of Canal de Isabel II, in the Community of Madrid" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Medio Ambiente, Comunidad de Madrid, Estaciones depuradoras, IDEM, Canal de Isabel II. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS, WFS. The listing shows 2026-03-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.es). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
